subject: Isishwankathelo sakho seVaultara se-{month}
preheader: Oko kuphelelwa kungekudala, oko sele kuphelelwe, kunye nokuba iindleko zokuhlaziya zingaba kangakanani.
heading: Isishwankathelo sakho se-{month}
intro: Nantsi into efuna ingqalelo yakho kwiVaultara.
nothingDue: Akukho nto iphelelwayo kule nyanga okanye kwelandelayo, kwaye akukho nto sele iphelelwe. Zonke izinto zilungile.
costsBody: Iirekhodi ezineendleko zokuhlaziya eziphelelwa ukuya kutsho ekupheleni kwe-{month} zidibana zibe:
footerWhy: Ufumana le imeyile kuba uvule isishwankathelo senyanga kwiVaultara.
unsubscribedBody: Awusayi kufumana isishwankathelo senyanga. Unokusivula kwakhona kwiVaultara ngaphantsi kwezaziso.
resubscribedBody: Uza kufumana isishwankathelo senyanga ngowokuqala wenyanga nganye.
invalidLinkBody: Unokucima isishwankathelo senyanga kwiVaultara ngaphantsi kwezaziso.
